variants.subject: Are you actively pursuing federal contracts?
variants.body:
Hi,
I came across your company and noticed your capabilities appear aligned with areas currently seeing active federal demand.

A lot of companies registered in SAM or even holding a GSA Schedule struggle to identify:
• which agencies actually buy their services
• which primes they should partner with
• where they realistically fit in the market
• and which opportunities are actually winnable

That’s specifically what we help companies solve at Pathways 2 Government Contracting.

Would it make sense to schedule a brief 15–20 minute conversation to discuss whether there may be viable federal growth paths?
Best,
Kevin Carter
Pathways 2 Government Contracting
https://calendly.com/kevin-pathways2gc/30min

variants.subject: Following up
variants.body:
Hi,

Wanted to follow up in case my last email got buried.

Based on your capabilities, there may be viable federal contracting opportunities worth exploring — especially with agencies actively buying in your space.

A lot of companies we speak with are unsure:
- where they realistically fit
- which agencies align best
- and whether pursuing GSA or VA paths even makes sense

That’s typically where we help.

Would a quick 15–20 minute conversation make sense next week?

Best,
Kevin Carter
Pathways 2 Government Contracting
https://calendly.com/kevin-pathways2gc/30min

variants.subject: Potential federal fit
variants.body:
Hi,

One thing we consistently see is companies technically capable of federal work but missing visibility into:

- which agencies are actively spending
- who the incumbent primes are
- whether they align competitively
- and which opportunities are realistically winnable

That usually leads to companies chasing bids that were never a strong fit to begin with.

We help companies identify where they actually fit in the market before they invest heavily into bidding.

Happy to do a quick review if useful.

Best,
Kevin Carter
Pathways 2 Government Contracting
https://calendly.com/kevin-pathways2gc/30min

variants.subject: Close the loop
variants.body:
Hi,

I know priorities shift and timing may not be right, so this will be my last follow-up for now.

If federal growth becomes a bigger priority later this year, feel free to reach back out and I’d be happy to reconnect.

Wishing you continued success either way.

Best,
Kevin Carter
Pathways 2 Government Contracting
https://calendly.com/kevin-pathways2gc/30min
